visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Calling a Function Expression Too Early
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The program should print hi, but it crashes with a TypeError because greet is not yet a function when it is called.

solution.explanation: For var greet = function () {...} only the name greet is hoisted, with the value undefined. The function is assigned when that line runs, so calling greet() earlier calls undefined. A function declaration, function greet() {...}, is hoisted with its body.
